CREATE POLICY delete_archived_metrics_recursive_subordinates ON product.metrics FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'product_manager' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND owner_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM hr.employees e WHERE e.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.feature_usage fu WHERE fu.product_id = e.employee_id AND fu.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND fu.last_active_at < now() - interval '1 year' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.feature_dependencies fd WHERE fd.feature_id = e.employee_id AND fd.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int)) WITH CHECK (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'product_manager' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND owner_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM hr.employees e WHERE e.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.feature_usage fu WHERE fu.product_id = e.employee_id AND fu.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND fu.last_active_at < now() - interval '1 year' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.feature_dependencies fd WHERE fd.feature_id = e.employee_id AND fd.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int));

CREATE POLICY delete_archived_analytics_recursive_subordinates ON product.analytics FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'data_analyst' AND owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::int AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND created_at < now() - interval '1 year' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.feature_usage WHERE feature_id = analytics.feature_id AND user_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::int AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int)) WITH CHECK (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'data_analyst' AND owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::int AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND created_at < now() - interval '1 year' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.feature_usage WHERE feature_id = analytics.feature_id AND user_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::int AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int);

CREATE POLICY delete_resolved_feedback_subordinates ON product.user_feedback FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'customer_support' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND customer_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true)::int AND feedback_status = 'Resolved' AND EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE subordinates(sub_id) AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM product.user_feedback WHERE customer_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true)::int AND employee_id = u.employee_id AND u.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int UNION SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM product.user_feedback WHERE customer_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true)::int AND employee_id = subordinates.sub_id)) AND created_at < app_now() - interval '30 days' AND created_at > app_now() - interval '60 days' AND created_at <= app_now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product.user_feedback f WHERE f.customer_id = product.user_feedback.customer_id AND f.employee_id = product.user_feedback.employee_id AND f.tenant_id = product.user_feedback.tenant_id AND f.feedback_status = 'Resolved' AND f.created_at > product.user_feedback.created_at));

CREATE POLICY pm_delete_archived_issues_recursive ON engineering.issues FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'project_manager' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM engineering.projects WHERE owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::int AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int) AND status = 'archived' AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days') WITH CHECK (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'project_manager' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM engineering.projects WHERE owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::int AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int) AND status = 'archived' AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days');

CREATE POLICY delete_archived_repos ON engineering.code_repository FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'senior_engineer' AND project_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND archived_at < app_now()::date - INTERVAL '90 days' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engineering.projects WHERE project_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer);

CREATE POLICY customer_draft_order_deletion ON sales.orders FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.customer_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND (current_setting('app.employee_id', true) = current_setting('app.customer_id', true) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.customers WHERE customer_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true) AND parent_customer_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true)) AND status = 'Draft' AND fulfillment_status = 'Unfulfilled' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true::integer));

CREATE POLICY finance_manager_voided_invoices ON sales.invoices FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'finance_manager' AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM sales.customers WHERE parent_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND is_active = true AND customer_type = 'customer' AND security_clearance <= 3) AND invoice_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' AND status = 'Voided' AND customer_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true)::int) WITH CHECK (current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'finance_manager' AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM sales.customers WHERE parent_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND is_active = true AND customer_type = 'customer' AND security_clearance <= 3) AND invoice_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' AND status = 'Voided' AND customer_id = current_setting('app.customer_id', true)::int);

CREATE POLICY delete_stale_attendance_corrections ON hr.attendance FOR DELETE USING (current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'manager' AND employee_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT child.manager_id FROM hr.employees AS child JOIN hr.employees AS parent ON child.manager_id = parent.employee_id) AND parent.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND parent.hire_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '30' DAY) WITH CHECK (current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'manager' AND employee_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT child.manager_id FROM hr.employees AS child JOIN hr.employees AS parent ON child.manager_id = parent.employee_id) AND parent.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND parent.hire_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '30' DAY);

CREATE POLICY finance_manager_region_balance_sheet ON finance.balance_sheet FOR ALL USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'finance_manager' AND region_id = current_setting('app.region_id', true)::integer) WITH CHECK (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'finance_manager' AND region_id = current_setting('app.region_id', true)::integer AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finance.balance_sheet bs WHERE bs.region_id <> current_setting('app.region_id', true)::integer AND bs.archived = true));

CREATE POLICY eng_managers_planned_hotfix_releases ON engineering.releases FOR ALL USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'engineering_manager' AND release_status IN ('Planned','Hotfix') AND EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE project_scope(project_id) AS (SELECT root.project_id FROM engineering.projects root WHERE root.owner_id = current_setting('app.employee_id', true)::integer AND root.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer UNION SELECT child.project_id FROM engineering.projects child JOIN project_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_project_id = parent_scope.project_id WHERE child.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::integer) SELECT 1 FROM project_scope WHERE project_scope.project_id = release.project_id) WITH CHECK (release.release_status IN ('Planned','Hotfix'));

CREATE POLICY finance_manager_region_bank_accounts ALL ON finance.bank_accounts FOR ALL USING (current_setting('app.job_role', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.employee_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.region_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) IS NOT NULL AND current_setting('app.job_role', true) = 'finance_manager' AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int AND ( region_id = current_setting('app.region_id', true)::int OR EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE rls_scope(node_id) AS ( SELECT child.region_id FROM hr.departments child WHERE child.parent_department_id = current_setting('app.region_id', true)::int AND child.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int UNION SELECT child.region_id FROM hr.departments child JOIN rls_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_department_id = parent_scope.node_id WHERE child.tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int ) SELECT 1 FROM rls_scope WHERE rls_scope.node_id = finance.bank_accounts.region_id ) AND account_status IN ('Active', 'Pending Review') AND WITH CHECK (region_id = current_setting('app.region_id', true)::int AND tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::int);
